name: Sunken Treasure
summary: Professor Phizzlethorpe and Doctor Draxlegauge now aid the Blackwater Raiders in their search for lost elven treasure. Before the search can begin, the professor needs your protection while he charges goggles for the dark sea.

sections.title: Charging the Goggles
sections.body: Professor Phizzlethorpe asks you to guard him as he prepares for a search beneath the dark sea. Doctor Draxlegauge built goggles to find the lost gems, but they need power from an enchanted stone in a cave a short way uphill. The cave is cursed, and those who draw near are ambushed. Defend the professor while he draws the stone’s energy into the goggles.

faq.answer: Professor Phizzlethorpe asks you to guard him on the way to and from the cave while he charges Doctor Draxlegauge’s goggles at the enchanted stone.

faq.q: Why do the goggles need to be charged?
faq.answer: Doctor Draxlegauge built the goggles to find the lost gems in the dark sea. They need the stone’s power before they can work.

faq.q: Why does the professor need an escort?
faq.answer: The cave is cursed, and those who draw near are ambushed. You need to defend Professor Phizzlethorpe while he channels the stone’s energy.

faq.q: Who are the professor and the doctor working for?
faq.answer: Professor Phizzlethorpe says he and Doctor Draxlegauge are now full-fledged Blackwater Raiders. Their duty is to help Mr. O’Breen find the lost elven treasure.
